name: Daily docs refresh
description: Keep the project documentation in sync on every weekday morning.

tasks.title: Refresh project documentation
tasks.description: Update the docs that drifted since the last run.
tasks.prompt:
Refresh this project's documentation.

The documentation directory for this run is $SCHEDULED_TASK_PARAM_DOCS_DIR (default: docs). Read it from the environment; never hardcode "docs".

Workspace contract (this task owns its own directory on disk):
- $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR is the task root and it belongs to this task; the app only writes task.json, prompt.md, README.md and runs/<runId>/ (run.json, prompt.md, output.md, logs/) there. Keep every long-lived cache, counter or note inside the root (for example $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR/state.json with the last documented commit) so the next run can continue instead of starting over; how to organize the root is this task's own choice.
- This run has its own $SCHEDULED_TASK_RUN_DIR with run.json, prompt.md, output.md and logs/ (written by the app); use it for per-run scratch if you like.
- Prefer keeping everything inside the task root and the project directory.

Steps:
1. Read $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR/state.json if it exists and diff the project against the recorded commit/state.
2. Update the affected Markdown files under $SCHEDULED_TASK_PARAM_DOCS_DIR (default docs), the README and any API docs.
3. Write the new state back to $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR/state.json and finish with a short summary of what changed.

params.name: docs_dir
params.description: Documentation directory (relative to the project root) this run reads and updates.
